newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht weaker late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht weaker late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at 7.00 percent in late trade on Tuesday from 6.50-7.00 percent early amid stable liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
"The interbank rate briefly rose above 7.00 percent late the morning on some strong dollar buying. But the rate then fell back," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the high money supply was attributed to government budget disbursements for the new fiscal period which began on October 1 and to money earned from recent sales on the stock market.
The baht was lower to 25.466-25.471 to the dollar late from 25.462-25.467 early, reflecting the U.S. unit's strength abroad, dealers said.
"People still took long dollar positions today, while the dollar's rise against the yen helped trigger more buying of the dollar," said one currency dealer.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 8.00/9.00 satangs per dollar late from 7.00/8.00 early.
The baht/dollar mid-rate was fixed by the Bank of Thailand unchanged at 25.44.
